permission.title: Let TaxPlot find deductions for you
permission.sub: Most of your deductible payments already happen automatically — insurance auto-debit, PPF SIP, EMI. We can spot them so you don't have to remember to log anything.
permission.row1Desc: We scan only for bank/UPI debit notifications — never personal messages. Matched against known insurers, PPF, EMI lenders.
permission.row2Desc: One tap to confirm it's deductible — no photo needed for auto-detected payments.
permission.note: You can turn this off anytime in Settings. Nothing is sent to us until you confirm a detected payment — we never auto-save without your review. (This demo simulates detection locally — no SMS is actually read.)

review.heading: Confirm this receipt
review.sub: We've filled this in — just check it's right.
review.rentPanRequiredNote: Your landlord's PAN is required once annual rent is above {{amount}}.
review.rentTdsWarning: Rent above {{threshold}}/month means you may need to deduct TDS under Section {{sectionNew}} (was {{sectionOld}}) — {{rate}}% with the landlord's PAN on file, {{noPanRate}}% without it.
review.rentPanAadhaarReminder: If your landlord's PAN isn't linked to their Aadhaar, a higher TDS rate can apply — worth checking before the year-end deduction.
review.familyNoneAdded: Add a {{relation}} in Settings → Family to tag whose this is.
review.microDisc: Saved amounts feed your dashboard estimate. Keep the original receipt/proof for filing — this app doesn't store legal proof of payment.
review.toastVendor: Add who this was paid to.
review.warnDuplicate: Saved — but this looks like a receipt you already logged (same payee, amount and date). Check your receipts list.
review.warnDateOutsideFY: Saved — but this date falls outside the current tax year. Double-check it's correct.
review.warnCash126Disallowed: Saved — but Section 126 (80D) premiums paid in cash generally aren't deductible. Only the preventive check-up line allows cash.
review.warnCash133OverLimit: Saved — but Section 133 (80G) cash donations above ₹2,000 aren't deductible. A non-cash payment would count in full.

overview.detectBannerMetaGeneric: Review to count them toward your deductions
overview.regimeCardTitleNewBetter: The New Regime is still lower for you
overview.regimeCardTitleOldBetter: The Old Regime is lower for you
overview.regimeCardBody: On what you've logged so far, it comes out {{amount}} cheaper. We re-check every time you add a receipt.
overview.oldRegimeNudgeTitle: The old tax regime works out cheaper
overview.oldRegimeNudgeBody: You'd pay {{amount}} less on the old tax regime. Tell your employer in April and your CA at filing time.
overview.emptyNote: No receipts logged yet. Snap your first one, or check Settings to turn on auto-detect.
overview.investmentsGloss: PPF, ELSS, life insurance, EPF, home loan principal, tuition fees
overview.extraNpsGloss: On top of Section 123 — separate {{cap}} bucket
overview.capNoteDone: Cap reached. Anything more here won't lower your tax.
overview.capNoteNone: If you pay this, it has its own cap on top of others.
overview.hraNote: Based on rent, salary and city. Log a rent receipt every month with the landlord's PAN — and check it's linked to their Aadhaar, since TDS can be higher if it isn't.
overview.donationsNote: 50% or 100% deductible depending on the fund — we'll flag which when you add the receipt.
overview.newRegimeMeta: Standard Deduction {{std}} · rebate if taxable income is up to {{threshold}}
overview.newRegimeBody: Most Section 123 (80C) and 126 (80D) style deductions don't apply here. We keep logging your receipts so you can compare at filing time. Your estimate: {{status}}.
overview.compareTie: Old and New Regime work out the same for you this year, based on what you've logged.
overview.compareOldCheaper: Old Regime would actually be {{amount}} cheaper for you this year, based on what you've logged.
overview.compareNewCheaper: New Regime is {{amount}} cheaper than Old Regime for you this year, based on what you've logged.

report.emptyReport: No deductions logged yet this year — snap a receipt to start building your report.
report.missedHeader: A few things you didn't log this year
report.employerPackNote: A simpler PDF grouped by section, for your employer's Jan–Feb Form 124 (was 12BB) investment declaration — not a tax computation.
report.postFilingRevisedDeadline: Revised return due by {{date}}, if you need to correct anything.
report.missedHealthSelf: No health insurance premium logged for yourself or family — if you paid one, add it before we finalize this report.
report.missedHealthParents: No health insurance premium logged for parents — if you pay one, it has its own Section 126 (80D) cap on top of your own.
report.missedHomeLoan: No home loan interest logged — check if this applies to you.
report.missedDonations: No donations logged — Section 133 (80G) gifts may still qualify.
report.missedNps: No extra NPS (Section 124) logged — an easy {{amount}} top-up bucket if you have room.
report.missedPreventiveCheckup: No preventive health checkup logged — it counts inside your Section 126 (80D) self/family cap, up to {{amount}}, even if paid in cash.
report.missedTuition: No tuition fees logged — the tuition component (not admission, transport or hostel fees) counts under Section 123 (80C), old regime only, for up to two children.
report.bigDisclaimer: This is an informational estimate based on what you logged — not a filed tax computation. Confirm final figures with your CA or the official portal before filing.
report.footerDisclaimer: Informational estimate — not tax advice. Not a filed return; cannot be submitted to the Income Tax Department.
